decision: Current first-pass release is Paper 1 and Paper 3; Paper 2 is later feasibility
alternative_rejected: Run all three papers in the first pass
reason: Supplied timeline explicitly sequences Paper 1 then Paper 3 and parks Paper 2

decision: Original IFLS materials under IFLS/ remain unchanged; working extractions/pointers live under 00_raw/
alternative_rejected: Edit or overwrite source archives
reason: Preserve reproducibility and source provenance

decision: Stata 16.1 console executable detected; edition label requires reconciliation with About output
alternative_rejected: Assume a different Stata version or edition
reason: Environment probe is the only current software evidence

decision: Primary is mother-led international work migration with verified work reason and verified destination outside Indonesia; domestic, any-parent, and unresolved episodes are supplementary or excluded
alternative_rejected: Use a broader any-parent or domestic treatment as primary
reason: A country or episode that is not verified must not be converted into an international treatment

decision: Primary is W1-only; W2 is a separate supplementary/replication cohort and is never silently pooled
alternative_rejected: Pool W1 and W2 after inspecting support
reason: W1 supplies the earliest baseline and longest follow-up

decision: Primary requires both parents linked/present and no evidence of baseline left-censoring; one-parent, known nonresident/dead, no-link, unknown, and ambiguous cases are sensitivity only
alternative_rejected: Treat every W1 parent status as pre-treatment
reason: Baseline covariates cannot be called pre-treatment when exposure may predate observation

decision: Primary is W2/W3 age 15 only; age 10-11 and 12-14 are descriptive/feasibility; W2 and W3 are reported separately or with an explicit wave indicator
alternative_rejected: Retain age 10-14 as inferential primary despite near-zero hours support
reason: Hours-module support is 0/5 for W2 and 0/1 for W3 in the proposed younger bands

decision: Chores are omitted from the primary and the paper is reframed as paid/market child labor; W1 chores may be exploratory only
alternative_rejected: Keep a gender/domestic-work claim without comparable hours
reason: W2/W3 do not provide an exact individual weekly housework-hour measure

decision: Primary uses codebook-valid last-week total hours from job 1 plus job 2, bounded 0-168, with age-15 threshold greater than 43; primary-job-only and normal-week rules are sensitivity only
alternative_rejected: Treat candidate threshold counts or special codes as final treatment
reason: The detailed modules have sparse younger-age support and special numeric/status codes

decision: Hazardous work is omitted from primary; raw occupation/industry evidence is retained for a future versioned authoritative mapping
alternative_rejected: Infer hazard from unverified occupation text or broad industry codes
reason: No authoritative mapping is present in the local project

decision: Primary is unweighted conditional association with robust VCE clustered at the estimand-specific household; official weights/PSU/strata/svyset are sensitivity only after target-population crosswalk
alternative_rejected: Copy a generic weight, PSU, or geography variable across waves
reason: The local audit found candidates but no complete official design specification

decision: Household PCE and cross-wave monetary comparison are omitted from primary; W5 earnings are within-wave only; PCE and NPV remain parked
alternative_rejected: Assume historical PCE is comparable through W5
reason: W5 PCE output is not identified and historical bases are incomplete

decision: Primary outcomes are separate W5 outcome families for adults age 17-36; W4 is supplementary; incomplete mental-health candidates are not labelled CES-D-10
alternative_rejected: Switch the outcome family or window after seeing coefficients
reason: W5 module coverage differs and b3b_vg is absent locally

decision: Ambiguous multi-resident, HHID mismatch, and unresolved lineage cases are excluded from primary and retained as flagged sensitivity cases
alternative_rejected: Silently assign the ambiguous person to a household
reason: The shared-spine gate passes keys but reports unresolved roster anomalies

decision: The 14-item IMDI is not primary; outcome-specific listwise is primary; a reduced index is supplementary only after indicator and missingness audit; MICE is sensitivity
alternative_rejected: Promote MICE or an incomplete IMDI to primary
reason: Several proposed IMDI/mental-health/PCE components are not fully supported locally

decision: Apply Benjamini-Hochberg within each predeclared outcome family
alternative_rejected: Correct across an unstructured set of all outcomes
reason: Family-level control preserves the research questions and prevents post-result grouping

decision: All first-pass coefficients are adjusted associations; causal wording, IV, mediation, PSM/IPW, Heckman, FE, NPV, and national aggregation are parked
alternative_rejected: Describe first-pass coefficients as causal effects
reason: Identification and extrapolation gates are not yet passed

decision: NPV is post-first-pass and scenario-only until earnings model, support, rates, and headcount are verified
alternative_rejected: Report a national loss number in the first pass
reason: Supplied timeline parks valuation

decision: A model requires at least 10 treated observations 5 treated clusters and 20 controls; below-gate outcomes remain non-inferential
alternative_rejected: Broaden the sample or lower the gate after seeing support
reason: R1 profit has 4 treated observations and is explicitly labelled support_below_gate

decision: Codebook recodes merges uniqueness sample flow and model metadata pass through the canonical Stata chain
alternative_rejected: Treat a successful command exit as sufficient evidence
reason: 30_final_quality_gate reports all analysis contracts pass

decision: Results are adjusted associations with outcome-specific listwise deletion and BH q-values within paper-by-family
alternative_rejected: Use causal effect wording or national-loss wording
reason: Identification and survey-provenance gates remain outside the first-pass release
